label: An event page
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Big+Shoulders+Display:wght@700;900&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap');
  /* A conference in Lisbon on a 76rem page: the announcement, a header bar, a full-width hero where the evening light
     moves behind the title and a ticket is pinned beside it, the evening party as a scene of its own, then countdown,
     programme, speakers and venue on one grid, and a dark band to close. Looks: Sunset (dusk plum and orange,
     follows light / dark), Aurora (night, the northern lights) and Poster (paper, black and one red). */
  #site-events {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.008 60);
    --foreground: oklch(0.24 0.04 300);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0.015 50);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.48 0.04 300);
    --border: oklch(0.9 0.02 40);
    --input: var(--border);
    --primary: oklch(0.6 0.2 20);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.01 60);
    --secondary: oklch(0.95 0.03 40);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.82 0.14 70);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.24 0.04 300);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 1rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --ev-display: 'Big Shoulders Display', Impact, sans-serif;
    --ev-ticket: oklch(0.99 0.01 80);
    --ev-ticket-ink: oklch(0.24 0.04 300);
    color-scheme: light;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    container-type: inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-family: 'Figtree', var(--font-sans);
  }
  .dark #site-events[data-look='sunset'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.19 0.04 300);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.015 60);
    --card: oklch(0.23 0.045 300);
    --muted: oklch(0.26 0.045 300);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.76 0.03 320);
    --border: oklch(0.34 0.05 300);
    --primary: oklch(0.72 0.18 25);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.18 0.04 300);
    --secondary: oklch(0.3 0.06 300);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='aurora'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0.035 260);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.02 180);
    --card: oklch(0.21 0.04 260);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0.045 260);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.78 0.04 200);
    --border: oklch(0.33 0.05 250);
    --primary: oklch(0.85 0.15 165);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.035 260);
    --secondary: oklch(0.27 0.05 260);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.75 0.15 300);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.17 0.035 260);
    --ev-ticket: oklch(0.85 0.15 165);
    --ev-ticket-ink: oklch(0.17 0.035 260);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.96 0.01 85);
    --foreground: oklch(0.15 0 0);
    --card: oklch(0.98 0.008 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.92 0.01 85);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.35 0.01 85);
    --border: oklch(0.15 0 0);
    --primary: oklch(0.57 0.23 28);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.008 85);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.01 85);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.15 0 0);
    --accent: oklch(0.57 0.23 28);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.008 85);
    --radius: 0rem;
    --ev-ticket: oklch(0.57 0.23 28);
    --ev-ticket-ink: oklch(0.98 0.008 85);
  }
  #site-events .ev-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-events[data-look='sunset'] .ev-look-only[data-for='sunset'],
  #site-events[data-look='aurora'] .ev-look-only[data-for='aurora'],
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] .ev-look-only[data-for='poster'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* every section on one 76rem grid; the hero, the party and the closing band run wall to wall */
  #site-events > :not(.mk-announcement, .mk-event-header, .parallax, .mk-cta, template) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
  }
  #site-events > :is(.mk-event-countdown, .mk-event-description, .ev-programme, .ev-speakers, .ev-venue) {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #site-events > .mk-event-countdown {
    padding-block-start: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  }
  #site-events .mk-announcement {
    margin: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  /* the header bar: the Site Header block - the name, the sections, the look, the language and the tickets */
  #site-events .ev-bar {
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-bar .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #site-events .ev-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem;
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  #site-events .ev-nav a {
    padding-block: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-nav a:hover,
  #site-events .ev-nav a[aria-current] {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-nav a[aria-current] {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
  }
  #site-events .ev-brand {
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
    font: 900 1.5rem/1 var(--ev-display);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-bar .select {
    min-width: 8rem;
  }
  /* the hero: wall to wall, the evening light behind the title */
  #site-events .mk-event-header {
    --ev-hero: oklch(0.2 0.05 320);
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: clip;
    display: grid;
    align-items: end;
    min-height: clamp(30rem, 68vh, 42rem);
    border-radius: 0;
    background: var(--ev-hero);
  }
  #site-events:is([data-look='sunset'], [data-look='aurora']) .mk-event-header {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.2 0.05 320 / 0.35);
    --card: oklch(0.2 0.05 320 / 0.6);
    --foreground: oklch(0.97 0.012 70);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.85 0.03 50);
    --border: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.22);
    --input: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.28);
    --primary: oklch(0.78 0.15 55);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.05 320);
    --secondary: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='aurora'] .mk-event-header {
    --ev-hero: oklch(0.15 0.035 260);
    --primary: oklch(0.85 0.15 165);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.15 0.035 260);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] .mk-event-header {
    --ev-hero: var(--card);
    border-block: 3px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header > .shader {
    mask-image: linear-gradient(100deg, oklch(0 0 0 / 0.55) 15%, #000 65%);
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header-inner {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 7rem) max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2)) clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: transparent;
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header-copy {
    max-width: 44rem;
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header-tagline {
    font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-stripes {
    --surface-size: 16px;
    --surface-ink: oklch(0.57 0.23 28 / 0.9);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 62%, #000 62%);
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header-title {
    font-family: var(--ev-display);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 6.5rem);
    line-height: 0.88;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] .mk-event-header-title {
    max-width: 9ch;
  }
  #site-events :is(.mk-session-item-title, .mk-event-countdown-title, .mk-event-description-body h2) {
    font-family: var(--ev-display);
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-header-meta {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  /* the ticket, torn off and pinned to the header */
  #site-events .ev-ticket {
    --shape-cut: 0.9rem;
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 5.5rem);
    right: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    width: 15rem;
    padding: 1.1rem 1.75rem;
    background: var(--ev-ticket);
    color: var(--ev-ticket-ink);
    rotate: 4deg;
    font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
    box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem -1rem oklch(0.2 0.05 300 / 0.6);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0.6rem 0.8rem oklch(0.2 0.05 300 / 0.35));
  }
  #site-events .ev-ticket b {
    font: 900 2.6rem/0.9 var(--ev-display);
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }
  #site-events .ev-ticket small {
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-ticket span {
    border-block-start: 1.5px dashed currentColor;
    padding-block-start: 0.4rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 52rem) {
    #site-events .ev-ticket {
      position: relative;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 1.5rem;
      rotate: -3deg;
    }
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] :is(.mk-session-item, .mk-event-countdown-inner) {
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the sections */
  #site-events .ev-section-title {
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
    font: 900 clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem)/1 var(--ev-display);
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-programme {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.875rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-speakers {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-speakers .mk-speaker-item img {
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #site-events .ev-venue {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 20rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  #site-events > .parallax {
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  /* the closing band keeps the ground between it and the footer, as every page does */
  #site-events > .mk-cta {
    margin: 0 0 clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  #site-events[data-look='aurora'] .mk-session-item {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 1px var(--border),
      0 0.75rem 2rem -1rem oklch(0.85 0.15 165 / 0.35);
  }
  /* light or dark: the Swap writes the page's dark class - every look has a light and a dark palette */
  #site-events .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #site-events [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the agenda's titles open their sessions */
  #site-events .mk-session-item-title a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .mk-session-item-title a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
  }
  #site-events .parallax a.badge {
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  /* around the summit: three Event Items on cards */
  #site-events > .ev-around {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-item {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] .mk-event-item {
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .mk-event-item-title a {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the pages: a session, a speaker, an event, the registration - a display title, the text beside a card of facts */
  #site-events
    > :is(
      [data-events-view='session'],
      [data-events-view='speaker'],
      [data-events-view='event'],
      [data-events-view='register']
    ) {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem) clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  }
  #site-events .ev-page {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-back {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    width: fit-content;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-back:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-back svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-kicker {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      700 0.875rem/1.4 'Space Mono',
      var(--font-mono);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-page-title {
    max-width: 52rem;
    margin: 0;
    font: 900 clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)/0.95 var(--ev-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-events .ev-lead {
    max-width: 44rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #site-events .ev-page-layout {
    display: grid;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    margin-block-start: 1rem;
  }
  @container (width > 52rem) {
    #site-events .ev-page-layout {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 20rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
  }
  #site-events .ev-prose {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    max-width: 44rem;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }
  #site-events .ev-prose p {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-events :is(.ev-prose, .ev-aside) h2 {
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
    font: 900 1.625rem/1 var(--ev-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-prose ul {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-start: 1.25rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-aside {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-events[data-look='poster'] .ev-aside {
    border: 2px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-aside .btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
  /* a speaker's page: the portrait beside the name, the talks as links in the aside */
  #site-events .ev-speaker {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1.5rem 2rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-speaker-photo {
    width: clamp(7rem, 18vw, 10rem);
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #site-events .ev-speaker-head {
    display: grid;
    flex: 1 1 20rem;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-talks {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-talks a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-talks a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  #site-events .ev-talks small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  #site-events .ev-people a {
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-events .mk-speaker-item-name a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .mk-speaker-item-name a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  #site-events .ev-people {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.875rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-people li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 3rem minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0.75rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  #site-events .ev-people img {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  #site-events .ev-people small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-facts {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-events .ev-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-facts dd {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #site-events .ev-photo {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-events .ev-photo img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 21 / 8;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-block-start: 2.5rem;
    padding-block-start: 1.5rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager a:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary);
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager a + a {
    text-align: end;
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font:
      700 0.8125rem/1.4 'Space Mono',
      var(--font-mono);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-pager strong {
    font: 900 1.375rem/1.05 var(--ev-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-register {
    max-width: 56rem;
  }
  #site-events .ev-done {
    display: grid;
    justify-items: start;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #site-events .ev-done > svg {
    width: 3rem;
    height: 3rem;
    padding: 0.625rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-done h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font: 900 2.25rem/1 var(--ev-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-done p {
    margin: 0;
  }
  /* the footer: the Site Footer block on the muted band */
  #site-events .ev-footer {
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--muted);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-events .ev-footer .mk-footer-inner {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) 0 2rem;
  }
  @container (width > 48rem) {
    #site-events .ev-footer .mk-footer-top {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.6fr);
      gap: 4rem;
    }
  }
  #site-events .ev-footer .mk-footer-brand-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 900 1.75rem/1 var(--ev-display);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-footer .mk-footer-heading {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      700 0.8125rem/1.4 'Space Mono',
      var(--font-mono);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-events .ev-footer :is(.mk-footer-list a, .mk-footer-social a) {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-events .ev-footer :is(.mk-footer-list a, .mk-footer-social a):hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
